[[File:Claws of Guthix icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Claws of Guthix''' is a [[combat spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring 60 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[Mage Arena I]] to cast. In addition, players must also be wielding a [[Guthix staff]], [[void knight mace]], or [[staff of balance]]. Only  the void knight mace and staff of balance are able to [[autocast]] the spell.

Initially, the spell can only be cast within the [[Mage Arena]] against the [[battle mage]]s. Upon casting the spell 100 times (regardless of whether it was a [[successful hit]] or not), the spell becomes usable outside the arena.

Claws of Guthix has a maximum hit of 20. Upon a successful hit, Claws of Guthix lowers the target's [[Defence]] by 1 + 5%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/463645094311366656|date=6 May 2014|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/I3a2i|archivedate=13 April 2023|quote=Saradomin: 1 prayer point flat rate. Guthix: 1 defence + 5%. Zamorak: 1 magic + 5%.}} This decrease does not stack nor will it reapply itself until the opponent returns to their base Defence level.

Like the other [[god spells]], the maximum hit is temporarily increased to 30 while the [[Charge]] spell is active and the respective [[god cape]] is worn.

Note that since Claws of Guthix requires a Guthix staff, void knight mace, or a staff of balance, rune-providing staves cannot be used. However, a [[tome of fire]] can be worn to provide infinite fire runes. This does not grant the damage boost from the tome and will not consume its charges.
